additional_info.subject: RE: ID0372956-DC/Si-D/BE[170001197] - P03_CableCheck fails CRM:00315001675
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco
I’m not convinced the problem is due to broken contactors. The charger next to it have the same problem and it seems too suspicious that these two chargers have exactly the same problem. Can you have a look in the EcoG on that timestemp and see if you can find anything.
Br.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0372956-DC/Si-D/BE[170001197] - P03_CableCheck fails CRM:00315001675
additional_info.body:
Francisco
Tried today to charge but was not able to, seems that there is something more fault then the contactors. Socket stays in preparing mode. Can you have a look in the ecog.
Br.
